item.description:
Added

  • German localization of the app, the menu bar app, the administrator password prompt and Sparkle's update window; Bromehew follows the system language ([#2](https://github.com/appnoe/bromehew/issues/2)).

Changed

  • The menu bar icon shows the state in colour: a green mug when everything is up to date, a red mug with the number of updates, an orange mug with “!” when something needs attention. Before the first check it keeps the menu bar's own colour ([#4](https://github.com/appnoe/bromehew/issues/4)).

Fixed

  • Open at login could not be switched on: macOS reports a login item that was never registered as “not found”, which disabled the toggle with a wrong hint about the Applications folder.

Added

  • About Bromehew shows the version, the publisher Appnö GmbH with the details of its legal notice and the Appnö logo (positive in light, negative in dark mode), and the license of Sparkle under Acknowledgements… ([#1](https://github.com/appnoe/bromehew/issues/1)).

Changed

  • The copyright of Bromehew and Bromehew Menu is held by Appnö GmbH.
  • The Help menu no longer links to the source repository, which is private.
